author: cmungall
body:
* **InterPro ID / label**

IPR000299 / FERM Domain

* **Example sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**

https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/P23458/entry JAK1

* **Description of issue**

The mapping between FERM and cytoskeleton leads to (what I believe to be) incorrect localization for JAK1. While this may not be entirely wrong (there is evidence of localization to cytoskeletal microdomains but this is likely not via this domain https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC3605687/)

Of course the association is correct for "typical" FERM domains such as those found in myosin genes (https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1002/cm.20426) but I think this may be adequately captured via other domain annotations?

For AI analysis. see:
https://www.perplexity.ai/search/is-jak1-localized-to-the-cytos-88KluvN2RX.yDASnkJMg1g
title: PR000299 / FERM Domain incorrectly associates JAK1 to the cytoskeleton
